parallel.requirements: Recognized the need for a cleanroom json-tui reimplementation with byte-level TUI behavior and no source lookup or wrapper shortcuts.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent planned probing, implementation, verification, and final build locally, then shifted into a nine-child AgentSwarm where every child owned only behavioral documentation.
parallel.implementation: No implementation was written; the concrete work was harness creation, PTY probing, captures, and six child notes files.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Child notes were returned in a single swarm result at cancellation and were not integrated into a codebase or final deliverable; artifact validation listed only original files.
parallel.verification: Verification consisted of observational byte probes against the original binary, not tests of a new executable; official evaluation later failed at compile time.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Three child scopes were aborted, no source code or compile.sh existed, and all official tests were not run because compilation failed.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same cleanroom reimplementation task and investigated json-tui behavior through normal executable interaction.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Single actor owned probing, future implementation, diff harnessing, and final build in its own todo list without child delegation.
serial.implementation: Serial wrote harness utilities and test/capture files but remained in behavioral probing and did not produce a clone implementation.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The final artifact included the harness directory along with original files, but no implementation source, compile script, or replacement executable.
serial.verification: Serial verified observations of the original executable through its harness, not a generated solution; official evaluation also failed at compile time.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run was cancelled during PageDown analysis with implementation, diff harness, and final build still pending.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run received and acknowledged the cleanroom requirement to write a new original executable solely from observed behavior.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run received the identical prompt and same cleanroom/no-source/no-wrapper constraints.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement difference; both understood the benchmark as behavioral reimplementation, not source lookup or wrapping.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent listed implementation/build tasks as pending, then launched nine subagents whose assignments were behavioral areas and notes files only.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial actor kept one todo pipeline that included probing, implementation, comparison, and final build steps in one context.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel separated research into child documentation work and deferred implementation; serial kept the later implementation tasks local but never reached them.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The child interface was a shared harness plus per-area notes path; the prompt expressly framed each child as an observer documenting behavior, not a component owner.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial actor used its own harness files and observations directly without cross-agent handoff contracts.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced a child handoff boundary around notes; serial had no inter-agent interface and no child result reduction step.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel created harnesses and child notes but did not create implementation source, compile script, or replacement executable in the submitted artifact.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial created harness utilities and JSON/capture files under /harness, but also did not create implementation source or a compileable deliverable.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel delivered less local artifact work than serial, but neither transitioned from probing into a reimplementation path.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The AgentSwarm result returned at cancellation with six completed child results and three aborted children.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial main actor was cancelled directly while still probing PageDown behavior, with no child result lifecycle.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a multi-child result lifecycle that was only exposed at closure; serial had ordinary single-actor cancellation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel shared /harness tools and notes across children, but the submitted artifact contained only the original workspace items and no /harness outputs or implementation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial's artifact preserved its harness directory and captures, but these were still observation aids rather than a buildable solution.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's child outputs were not integrated into the final tree; serial's harness files were present but still not a solution.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The official evaluation completed but failed at compile_failed, with all 894 tests not run.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The official evaluation also completed with compile_failed and all 894 tests not run.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No evaluator-outcome difference; neither run had a compileable submission for runtime verification.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel timed out after heavy swarm use: 386 LLM requests, 17.7M tokens, 503 tool calls, one AgentSwarm, and nine subagents.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also timed out, but with no delegation, 43 LLM requests, 3.1M tokens, and 48 tool calls.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel consumed far more budget in parallel behavioral exploration; serial consumed its budget in a single long probe sequence.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current official cell/status.json evaluations are not discordant: both runs failed at compile_failed with 0/894 tests run. The concrete task-solving difference is process-level: parallel spent its parallelism on documentation-only children and never integrated a codebase, while serial stayed in one actor and left implementation pending after extensive probing. Both ultimately omitted the required compileable reimplementation.
parallel_contributors: Nine-child documentation-only swarm deferred productive implementation until after behavioral research.
Swarm result returned at cancellation with three aborted scopes and no parent integration window.
Parallel artifact lacked implementation source or build files.
serial_contributors: Serial retained implementation and build tasks locally but timed out during probing before reaching them.
Serial artifact contained harness files, not a compileable clone.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Neither run wrote the actual reimplementation required by the benchmark.
The compile_failed result is an ordinary delivery failure shared by both modes, not a parallel-only evaluator effect.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained pattern is a parallel adverse process pattern, not a discordant-outcome root cause
